result.summary: Several layout and content issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, a restaurant card is cut off at the bottom, and the Profile tab appears selected on the Home screen.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol) is cropped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent card widths, padding, and horizontal scrolling so names and images are fully visible, or wrap/truncate names with ellipsis.

issues.description: The last popular restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so the last card sits fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right; the last chip is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip scroller has enough trailing padding or a fade so the last item is not cut mid-chip.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights Profile in green while the visible screen is the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Keep the Home tab selected/highlighted when this screen is shown.
